items.title: The status palette keeps its size when the map is zoomed out
items.do: Zoom the map far out (the farthest zoom), right-click Kaela's token and open the effects palette (the Token HUD's effects button). Do the same at 100%, then zoomed in past 100%, and once with Kaela's token near the right or bottom edge of the screen while zoomed out.
items.expect: Zoomed out, the palette is the same readable size as at 100% (its names as easy to read), still beside its button and inside the window (near an edge it moves back inside); at 100% and zoomed in it is exactly as before. The icons on Kaela's token itself are as before v0.0.532 (they shrink with the map, as Foundry draws them). A click on a row still toggles its condition. If the palette jumps away from its button, say where (Foundry's own placement could not be tried here).

items.title: "1[D] + [Mod]" is in the damage color
items.do: Open Durgan's Basic Attack card (the sheet, the HUD's card, and a roll of it in the chat).
items.expect: Tier 3's "1[W] + 1[D] + [Mod]" is all in the Vigor damage color on every face, as Tier 2's "1[W] + [Mod]" is.

items.title: The roll's breakdown is a written sum
items.do: Sylwen makes her Basic Attack on a Goblin Sneak that has Low cover, with Shifting Aim on (the case of Lucas's picture), in a chat about 220 to 232 px wide. Click the card's ladder; click it again.
items.expect: The breakdown is closed at first and opens under the ladder, across the card's whole width. Each line starts with its number in one column: the dice's sum with the two dice beside it, "+N Weapon", "+0 Boons and Banes · 2 and 2 cancel" (or what the roll had), then each Boon and Bane on its own line, number first, the name, its kind in words ("(Field)"); a rule, then "16 against [AD 14]" with the Tier at the right. No number is torn from its name, a long name wraps under itself, nothing leaves the card. A Flat from the dialog is its own line ("+1 Situational"); with Killer's Focus, an "Applied: Killer's Focus" line under the total.

items.title: Favored, Doomed, a name's limit, a Critical in the breakdown
items.do: Sylwen attacks a Goblin Sneak while Hidden (Favored); then while Engaged (Doomed); then with three Field Boons on one roll (Flanking with Durgan, the Goblin Prone, Shifting Aim); then roll until Doubles on a Tier 3 or 20 over (Forced Tier: Critical is fine). Open each breakdown.
items.expect: Favored / Doomed: the dice's line shows three dice, the dropped one dashed and struck, "3d12, the N is dropped"; the line "+0 Boons and Banes · Favored: 5 Boons left" (or Doomed, Banes) and the source as "+5 Hidden (Favored: counts as 5 Boons)". The third Field is struck through, "0", "(Field: 2 at most)". A Critical: "Tier 3, Doubles:" (or "20 over") then the gold Critical; Doubles that raise a Tier: "Tier 2, Doubles:" then Tier 3. A roll posted before v0.0.533 still opens (Favored then reads "+5 Favored (counts as 5 Boons)", no name).

items.title: A Save's breakdown: the target rolls
items.do: Durgan uses Rebuke on a Goblin Sneak with a Bane on Durgan's side (so it turns into the goblin's Boon); the goblin rolls its Save; open its breakdown from the ladder.
items.expect: "Goblin Sneak rolls" above the sum; its Attribute as the Modifier line; "+1 Caster's Banes" among its Boons; the total "against [DC N]" and "Their Tier N"; never a Critical.

items.title: Several targets: each row opens its own breakdown
items.do: Sylwen's Volley (or the Ogre Chieftain's Great Sweep) on three creatures, one with cover; click each creature's small ladder.
items.expect: Each opens that creature's own written sum under its row (the shared dice repeated in each, its own Boons, Banes, Defense and Tier). With "Hide enemy Defenses" on, a player sees the badge "AD" without its number and no "20 over".

items.title: Grabbed makes the creature Vulnerable 1 while held
items.do: Update the Conditions from the compendium (or use a fresh world). The Ogre Chieftain Grabs Aveline (Crushing Grip's Tier 3, or Grabbed by the ogre from the Token HUD). A Goblin Sneak attacks Aveline with its Shiv (look at the roll dialog). Then Aveline uses Break Free and succeeds.
items.expect: While held, Aveline shows Grabbed with Immobilized and Vulnerable 1 linked under it; the goblin's roll dialog against her shows the Vulnerable chip (1 Boon). If she already had Vulnerable 2, only the 2 counts. When Grabbed ends (Break Free, or the ogre lets go), the Immobilized and the Vulnerable 1 go with it; nothing to remove by hand.

items.title: Rev 4 · The Token HUD sits under every window; its Lingering click still adds or ends one
items.do: Select Kaela (or the Orc Warrior) and open her character sheet. Right-click her token so Foundry's Token HUD shows (combat toggle, the status palette, the Vigor / Resolve boxes), then drag the sheet over the HUD. Open the status palette and click Lingering: give 1d6 Fi in the window that opens; click Lingering again and choose "Add another Lingering", then once more and choose "End" on one.
items.expect: The sheet covers the Token HUD where they overlap (the HUD is under it, not drawn through it); the Lingering damage window opens above the Token HUD, and any other window (the sheet, a pick window) is above it too. The Token HUD's Vigor / Resolve boxes and its status palette are still above the system's HUD bar at the bottom. With a Lingering already on, the click asks in the bottom bar "Add another Lingering", one "End Lingering ..." for each, and Cancel; "End" removes only that one.

items.title: Rev 3 · Charge is Melee only, and asks for the weapon once
items.do: Durgan (Arming Sword) Charges an Orc Warrior 5 squares away and makes the granted Basic Attack (1A) from the HUD's Situational tab. Then Sylwen with only her Hunting Bow in hand uses Charge. Then Sylwen with her Dagger in hand Charges an orc about 6 squares away. Last, the Ogre Chieftain Charges Aveline from about 6 squares.
items.expect: Durgan stops adjacent and his Basic Attack opens on the Arming Sword with no "Which weapon?" question and no second Roll button for another weapon. Sylwen with only the bow is refused at once ("can't Charge without a Melee weapon in hand"), no AP spent. With the Dagger she gets no question either: she stops adjacent (the Dagger in hand, Range 1) and attacks with it in hand (no "Thrown" notice). The ogre stops 2 squares from Aveline (Crushing Grip's Reach (2)) and attacks with Crushing Grip, never Roar.

items.title: A Prone, Unconscious or dead creature causes no Collision
items.do: Kill the Orc Warrior (or mark it Dead) and knock a Goblin Sneak Prone. Durgan uses Shove (or any Push) on the other Goblin Sneak so that its line passes through the dead orc's square, then through the Prone goblin's square, to a free square beyond. Then aim a Push to end exactly on the Prone goblin's square.
items.expect: The Push passes through both and lands beyond them, with no "hits" plate, no damage to anyone, and the log's line has no "(hits ...)". Aimed on the Prone goblin's square, it stops on the square before it: the plate says "not in a lying creature's space", no Collision and no damage. A standing creature in the way is still a Collision as before.

items.title: Rev 2 · The Advance's area: an ally's space is crossed, not a stop
items.do: Put Kaela next to Aveline (Aveline between Kaela and an open space) and click Aveline's Advance in the HUD on Aveline's turn. Then, on another turn, give Kaela a Crawl (1 AP) first, then an Advance.
items.expect: Aveline's area goes past Kaela's square at 1 more a step (v0.0.533: Difficult Terrain counts 1 more; it reaches 1 square less beyond Kaela than in open ground); Kaela's own square is hatched and not filled as a square Aveline can stop in. After Kaela's Crawl is used up, her Advance's area again counts Difficult Terrain and allies' squares as 1 more (the Crawl's "ignores Difficult Terrain" ended with it).

items.title: The second diagonal counts across two drags
items.do: On Sylwen's turn, note her squares left, drag her token 1 square diagonally and drop it; then drag her 1 more square diagonally and drop it; read the squares left in the movement bar after each drop. Then end her turn and start Kaela's: drag Kaela 1 square diagonally.
items.expect: The first drop costs 1 square, the second 2 (the second diagonal costs 2, as in one drag of 2 diagonals); the area drawn after the first drop already shows the next diagonal costing 2. Kaela's first diagonal on her own turn costs 1 (the count starts again on a new turn).

items.title: Difficult Terrain counts 1 more (a second diagonal 3)
items.do: On Kaela's turn, Advance her diagonally twice into rubble (a Difficult Terrain region) or past Sylwen's square, reading the squares left after each drop; then one straight step into Difficult Terrain. Open her Advance's area from the HUD first.
items.expect: The first diagonal into Difficult Terrain costs 2, the second diagonal 3 (not 4), a straight step 2; the ruler's number, the squares charged and the area drawn before the drag agree. A square that is Difficult Terrain twice (Darkness and an ally's space) still costs 1 more, not 2. A Crawl's Advance still pays nothing more.

items.title: A creature the Action kills is still pushed, and its body collides
items.do: Durgan's Shove (or Aveline's Word of Radiance) kills a Goblin Sneak standing next to the Orc Warrior, the Push aimed so the body goes into the orc.
items.expect: The Push is offered on the dead goblin as on a living one (the bar or the drag tool), its body moves and stops against the orc: the line says it hits the Orc Warrior, and the orc takes the Collision's damage (1 a square unused); the goblin's body takes it too (it is dead: nothing changes for it). A dead creature in the way (not the moved one) is still passed through.

items.title: Judge's card names the creature retargeted while the dialog is open
items.do: Durgan targets the Grave Wisp and uses Judge (1 AP); while its roll dialog is open, target the Ogre Chieftain on the map (T, not the dialog's Target button), then press Roll.
items.expect: The card that posts names the Ogre Chieftain, and the ogre carries the Judged mark (the Wisp doesn't). The same holds for any Action: the Action resolves on the creatures targeted when Roll is pressed.

items.title: Marks in the Situational tab, and Apply effect on the card
items.do: Durgan Judges the Grave Wisp, then (from his Shield of Faith or a Taunt) Taunts the Ogre Chieftain; select Durgan and open the HUD's Situational tab. Click the ✕ on the Wisp's row, then on the ogre's. Then click the "Apply effect" button on Judge's card with the Wisp targeted; then with nothing targeted.
items.expect: A "Marks" entry (by you · 2) lists "Grave Wisp · Judged" and "Ogre Chieftain · Taunted", each with a ✕; it folds on its title like Hiding, and its buttons never move. Each ✕ removes that one and posts a short system line ("... is no longer Judged by Durgan (removed by hand)"); the Wisp's ring goes. Apply effect marks the targeted Wisp again; with nothing targeted it marks the card's own target.

items.title: Taunted takes no Bane when the taunter is among the targets
items.do: Durgan Taunts the Ogre Chieftain (or apply Taunted by Durgan from the Token HUD). On the ogre's turn, use Great Sweep (or any Action with several targets) against Durgan and Aveline; then against Aveline alone.
items.expect: With Durgan among the targets the roll dialog shows no Taunted chip (no Bane); against Aveline alone it shows Taunted (1 Bane).

items.title: The Encounter Log: Collision in Raw, the Saves, Weak, the title
items.do: Run a short fight with all four creatures: the Ogre Chieftain's Backhand Pushes Kaela into a wall (or a creature), the ogre uses Crack the Ground on two PCs who both pass, Durgan hits the Grave Wisp with Drawing Light (Holy: its Weakness 3), then end the combat and Copy for Analysis.
items.expect: Kaela's Collision damage is in the Raw column (not Adjust), with the ogre as its origin. Crack the Ground writes one line a PC: "Aveline: Instinct Save N vs DC N (Crack the Ground) T3" even when nobody is hurt (the Grave Wisp's Dying Flare too). The Wisp's Raw includes its Weakness's extra (Raw is never below Net). The report's title lists every kind of enemy (Ogre Chieftain, Orc Warrior, Grave Wisp, Goblin Sneak).
